note: Jamsocket (YC Winter 2022, founded 2021 by Paul Butler and Taylor Baldwin, ex-Drifting in Space) was acquired by Modal on 2025-07-10; its hosted platform was subsequently wound down (per provider card: hosted platform terminated 2026-03-04, signups closed since 2026-01-08), with Plane and Y-Sweet continuing as MIT open-source projects. No funding amounts, round details, or revenue figures were disclosed in any source found; treat funding/revenue fields as unknown rather than zero.
